title: HarnessBridge: Learnable Bidirectional Controller for LLM Agent Harness
title_zh: HarnessBridge：用于 LLM Agent Harness 的可学习双向控制器
abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents for long-horizon tasks, yet their performance is shaped not only by model capability and environment design, but also by the harness that mediates agent--environment interaction. Existing harnesses are largely manually engineered, making them difficult to scale as trajectories grow longer and interactions become more complex. In this work, we ask whether harness can be generated by a learnable plug-in module that can be trained in an end-to-end fashion. We introduce HarnessBridge, a lightweight learnable harness controller that parameterizes the agent--environment interface as a bidirectional projection. HarnessBridge learns two bidirectional projections: observation projection, which distills raw trajectories into compact, decision-relevant states, and action projection, which converts proposed actions into executable transitions or trajectory-grounded rejections. We train HarnessBridge on a harness supervision dataset via unified instruction tuning. On Terminal-Bench~2.0 and SWE-bench Verified, HarnessBridge matches or surpasses strong specialized harnesses while substantially reducing token usage and trajectory length, and generalizes from smaller generators to larger commercial models.
abstract_zh: 本文关注 LLM 作为 Agent 执行长程任务时的交互中介——harness。现有 harness 多依赖人工工程设计，随着轨迹变长、交互复杂度上升，难以扩展。作者提出 HarnessBridge，一个轻量级、可端到端训练的可学习 harness 控制器，将 Agent 与环境之间的接口建模为双向投影：observation projection 将原始轨迹压缩为紧凑且与决策相关的状态；action projection 将模型提出的动作转换为可执行转移，或基于轨迹给出拒绝。HarnessBridge 通过统一 instruction tuning 在 harness supervision dataset 上训练。在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 SWE-bench Verified 上，HarnessBridge 能匹配或超过强专用 harness，同时显著降低 token 使用量和轨迹长度，并能从较小生成器泛化到更大的商业模型。
key_points_zh: 提出 HarnessBridge，将 LLM Agent 与环境交互的 harness 从人工设计转为可学习插件模块。
核心机制是双向投影：observation projection 压缩轨迹状态，action projection 规范化动作执行或拒绝。
通过统一 instruction tuning 在 harness supervision dataset 上进行端到端训练。
在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 和 SWE-bench Verified 上达到或超过强专用 harness。
在保持性能的同时显著减少 token 消耗和轨迹长度，并具备跨模型泛化能力。

llm_assessment.comment: HarnessBridge is relevant and reusable because it learns the agent-environment interface from trajectory supervision, reducing manual harness engineering for long-horizon agents.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: HarnessBridge从轨迹监督中学习智能体与环境接口，减少长程智能体的人工框架工程，具有较好的复用价值。
